name: 更好的故障机器人 / Better Defect
author: Codex
description: v103/vPC/v110 compatible full build: restores 26 old Defect cards, fixes Fission orb visuals, restores the starter Strike -> Ball Lightning replacement, no BaseLib. 10 historical versions and 59 custom transformations use a persistent 50-point budget: 25 blue Normal points, 10 yellow Overclock points and 15 red Overload points. v0.11.35 removes dynamic reward odds and card disabling from BetterDefect; both now live in the standalone DynamicCardOdds mod, and disabled cards no longer consume transformation points. Existing transformation choices are migrated to a dedicated BetterDefect state file.
